statement:
The record shows that the membership was still active and set to renew, but Tomas Vega cancelled in writing on 3 July and received email confirmation from the club.

I will refuse the charge.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer names the contradiction — "the record shows... membership was still active and set to renew, but Tomas Vega cancelled in writing on 3 July and received email confirmation" — and refuses the charge on that basis.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
